body_markdown:
We’re excited to share **One Degree’s 2025–2026 Annual Impact Report,** reflecting on a year of progress and an important new chapter in our work to strengthen the social safety net.


This year has reinforced something we’ve learned through more than a decade of working alongside communities: finding help is only the beginning. What matters most is making sure people can actually receive the support they need.


With that in mind, we’ve taken some exciting steps forward. From developing new AI-powered tools to deepening partnerships with trusted community organizations, we’re reimagining how people connect to essential services and benefits. After years of laying the groundwork, we’re entering a new chapter for One Degree, and I’m excited about what’s ahead.


None of this would be possible without the people and partners who believe in our mission. Thank you for helping us reach this moment and for being part of what comes next.


We encourage you to take a moment to explore the report and see the impact your support made possible.


[Read the Annual Impact Report](https://about.1degree.org/annual-impact-report/)


As our work expands to meet rising community needs, your support helps fuel the innovation and collaboration required to strengthen the safety net for everyone. Every donation counts!


**[Donate Now](https://about.1degree.org/donate/)**


We’re grateful to have you with us in this work.


With gratitude,
The One Degree Team
